purpose: reading-comprehension items; the contradicted item is composed by the pipeline from basis+alter and always shown with its label

statements.label: supported
statements.text: T cell infiltration was prognostic only in three settings: melanoma with high ultraviolet exposure, breast cancer with high homologous recombination deficiency signature, and lung adenocarcinoma with high tobacco signature.
statements.evidence: T cell infiltration levels only served as a prognostic biomarker in melanoma patients with high ultraviolet radiation exposure, breast cancer patients with high homologous recombination deficiency signature, and lung adenocarcinoma patients with high tobacco-associated mutational signature.
statements.note: The abstract lists exactly these three signature-defined contexts in which T cell infiltration served as a prognostic biomarker.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Among the signatures examined, the Clock-like signature showed the most widespread association with the tumour microenvironment.
statements.evidence: Our analysis revealed a varied association between mutational signatures and TME, with the Clock-like signature showing the most widespread influence.
statements.note: The abstract reports the Clock-like signature, not AID/APOBEC, as having the most widespread influence on the tumour microenvironment.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Tumours with high Clock-like signature activity respond better to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
statements.evidence: The results highlight the importance of considering both mutational signatures and immune phenotypes in cancer research and their significant implications for developing personalized cancer treatments and more effective immunotherapy.
statements.note: The abstract mentions implications for immunotherapy in general but reports no treatment response data for any signature.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Risk scores built from mutational signatures attributed mainly to Clock-like and AID/APOBEC activity stratified survival strongly across cancer types.
statements.evidence: Risk scores based on mutational signatures mainly induced by Clock-like and AID/APOBEC activity exhibited strong pan-cancer survival stratification ability.
statements.note: The abstract reports that these signature-based risk scores had strong pan-cancer survival stratification ability.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: IRAP-PCR banding patterns of Nikita and Sukkula distinguished the three goose populations from one another.
statements.evidence: Inter-retrotransposonamplified polymorphism-polymerase chain reaction (IRAP-PCR) method was performed for these retrotransposons movements in three diverse domestic goose populations (Chinese x Embden crossbred, Turkish White, and Turkish Multicolor).
statements.note: The abstract reports polymorphism rates within and across populations but never tests whether the markers separate the populations.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Across all samples, Sukkula polymorphism ratios reached as high as 73%, whereas Nikita polymorphism did not exceed 33%.
statements.evidence: Polymorphism ratios were between 0 and 33% in all samples for Nikita and 0-73% in all samples for Sukkula
statements.note: The abstract gives polymorphism ranges of 0-33% for Nikita and 0-73% for Sukkula across all samples.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In silico analysis supported movements of retrotransposons within the family Anatidae.
statements.evidence: In silico analyses supported the transitions of retrotransposons in the family Anatidae.
statements.note: The abstract states that in silico analyses supported retrotransposon transitions within Anatidae.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: No Sukkula polymorphism was detected among the Turkish White goose samples.
statements.evidence: There was no polymorphism for Sukkula among Turkish White samples.
statements.note: The abstract reports no Sukkula polymorphism in Turkish White geese, whereas Turkish Multicolor showed 0-50% for Sukkula.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: ctDNA-positive patients had significantly shorter median overall survival than ctDNA-negative patients.
statements.evidence: ctDNA-positive patients have significantly worse median overall survival than ctDNA-negative patients (29.0 months vs. 47.4 months, respectively).
statements.note: The abstract reports 29.0 months median overall survival for ctDNA-positive versus 47.4 months for ctDNA-negative patients.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Of 776 mCRPC patients, 59% were ctDNA-positive, including 26% with high ctDNA aneuploidy.
statements.evidence: Of 776 patients, 59% are ctDNA-positive, with 26% having high ctDNA aneuploidy
statements.note: The abstract gives 59% ctDNA positivity among 776 patients, with 26% showing high ctDNA aneuploidy.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Adding abiraterone to enzalutamide improved survival in ctDNA-positive patients.
statements.evidence: We develop a custom targeted cfDNA sequencing assay, named AR-ctDETECT, to detect ctDNA in limiting plasma cfDNA available from mCRPC patients in the Alliance A031201 randomized phase 3 trial of enzalutamide with or without abiraterone.
statements.note: The abstract names the trial arms but reports no comparison of outcomes between enzalutamide alone and enzalutamide plus abiraterone.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: mCRPC patients classified as ctDNA-positive by AR-ctDETECT had poor survival despite treatment with potent AR inhibitors.
statements.evidence: Here, we show that mCRPC patients identified as ctDNA-positive using the AR-ctDETECT assay have poor survival despite treatment with potent AR inhibitors in a phase 3 trial.
statements.note: The abstract concludes that ctDNA-positive patients had poor survival even under potent AR inhibition in the phase 3 trial.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Repetitive elements accounted for 42.82% to 60.86% of the genome across the ten Tetrigidae species, lowest in Thoradonta yunnana and highest in Saussurella cornuta.
statements.evidence: RE content constitutes between 42.82% (in Thoradonta yunnana) and 60.86% (in Saussurella cornuta) of their genomes
statements.note: The abstract reports RE content ranging from 42.82% in T. yunnana to 60.86% in S. cornuta.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Helitron elements were the single most abundant TE superfamily in every Tetrigidae species examined.
statements.evidence: with major components including LINEs, LTR/Gypsy, LTR/Copia, and DNA transposons (Maverick and Helitron)
statements.note: The abstract lists Helitrons among the major repeat components but never ranks superfamilies by abundance.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Large-genome species such as S. cornuta (2.836 Gb) and Formosatettix gonggashanensis (1.465 Gb) experienced both ancient and recent bursts of TE activity.
statements.evidence: species with large genomes, such as S. cornuta (2.836 Gb) and Formosatettix gonggashanensis (1.465 Gb), have experienced both ancient and recent bursts of TE activity
statements.note: RepeatMasker divergence analysis in the abstract shows both old and recent TE bursts in these two large-genome species.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Across the ten species, repeat and TE content showed a strong positive correlation with genome size.
statements.evidence: We observed a strong positive correlation between repeat and TE content with genome size, suggesting genome expansion in Tetrigidae is likely driven primarily by repetitive DNA, particularly transposable elements.
statements.note: The abstract reports a strong positive correlation between repeat/TE content and genome size, supporting repeat-driven genome expansion.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In cisplatin-treated TNBC patient-derived xenografts, the analysis detected therapy-induced mutagenesis together with inactivation of APOBEC3 activity.
statements.evidence: In cisplatin-treated TNBC patient-derived xenografts, we identify therapy-induced mutagenesis and inactivation of APOBEC3 activity.
statements.note: The abstract reports both therapy-induced mutagenesis and loss of APOBEC3 activity in the cisplatin-treated TNBC xenografts.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In HGSOC, APOBEC3 mutagenesis followed two different patterns: late tumour-wide activation in one case and clade-specific enrichment in another.
statements.evidence: In HGSOC, we show distinct patterns of APOBEC3 mutagenesis, including late tumor-wide activation in one case and clade-specific enrichment in another.
statements.note: The abstract describes these two distinct APOBEC3 patterns in the HGSOC cases.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: In PDAC, mismatch repair deficiency activity increased over time.
statements.evidence: In PDAC, we observe a temporal increase in mismatch repair deficiency (MMRd).
statements.note: The abstract reports a temporal increase, not a decrease, in mismatch repair deficiency in PDAC.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: ArtiCull removed more SNV artifacts than existing single-cell variant filtering tools on the same data.
statements.evidence: we introduce ArtiCull, a method to identify and remove SNV artifacts by leveraging evolutionary constraints, enabling reliable detection of mutations for signature analysis.
statements.note: The abstract describes what ArtiCull does but reports no comparison against other filtering tools.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The Random Survival Forest immune signature also predicted radiographic tumour response to immunochemotherapy.
statements.evidence: Machine learning validation confirms a predictive signal in the peripheral immune profile of SCLC patients.
statements.note: The abstract evaluates survival concordance only and never assesses radiographic tumour response.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Absolute immune values measured after two cycles of ICT yielded no significant prognostic signal.
statements.evidence: Crucially, absolute values measured after two cycles of ICT ( V 1 ) yielded no significant signal ( p = 0.445).
statements.note: The abstract reports no significant signal (p = 0.445) for absolute values after two cycles, in contrast to baseline and dynamic measures.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Baseline peripheral immune profiles achieved a concordance index of 0.66 (p = 0.015) for survival prediction.
statements.evidence: Baseline immune profiles ( V 0 ) achieved a concordance index (C-index) of 0.66 ( p = 0.015)
statements.note: The abstract reports a C-index of 0.66 with p = 0.015 for baseline (V0) immune profiles.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Regression models failed to generalise, with R² below zero, whereas censoring-aware Random Survival Forests extracted robust prognostic signatures.
statements.evidence: Under model-appropriate metrics, regressors did not generalise ( R 2 < 0); conversely, censoring- aware Random Survival Forests (RSF) successfully extracted robust prognostic signatures.
statements.note: The abstract contrasts regressors with negative R² against Random Survival Forests, which produced robust signatures.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Rapid promoter evolution was a shared feature of piRNA factors involved in germline silencing across insect species.
statements.evidence: Our findings indicate that rapid promoter evolution is a common trait among piRNA factors engaged in germline silencing across insect species
statements.note: The abstract reports rapid promoter evolution of germline piRNA factors as a common trait across insect species, not only in Drosophila.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Promoters of mammalian germline piRNA factors show the same rapid evolution.
statements.evidence: Our findings indicate that rapid promoter evolution is a common trait among piRNA factors engaged in germline silencing across insect species, potentially contributing to gene expression divergence in closely related taxa.
statements.note: The abstract analyses Drosophila and other insects only; mammals are never examined.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In Drosophila, the piRNA pathway relies on three gonad-specific Argonaute proteins that bind piRNAs of 23-28 nucleotides.
statements.evidence: In Drosophila, this pathway relies on three gonad-specific Argonaute proteins (Argonaute-3, Aubergine and Piwi) that associate with 23-28 nucleotide piRNAs
statements.note: The abstract names Argonaute-3, Aubergine and Piwi as the three gonad-specific Argonautes bound to 23-28 nucleotide piRNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Promoters of genes expressed exclusively in germ cells generally evolved rapidly, accompanied by some divergence in gene expression.
statements.evidence: we observe that the promoters of genes exclusively expressed in germ cells generally exhibit rapid evolution, with some divergence in gene expression.
statements.note: The abstract reports rapid promoter evolution with some expression divergence for genes expressed only in germ cells.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In 50 prospective intraoperative cases, ROBIN's classification agreed with the final integrated diagnosis 90% of the time.
statements.evidence: Classifier performance demonstrated concordance with final integrated diagnosis in 90% of prospective cases.
statements.note: The abstract reports 90% concordance between classifier output and final integrated diagnosis in the prospective cases.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Diagnostic turnaround time in the 50 prospective cases was under 2 hours.
statements.evidence: We demonstrate classifier performance on 50 prospective intraoperative cases, achieving a diagnostic turnaround time under 2 hours and generating robust tumour classifications within minutes of sequencing.
statements.note: The abstract reports a diagnostic turnaround time under 2 hours, with classifications within minutes of sequencing.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: ROBIN detected SNVs, CNVs and structural variants in real time and could inform a complete integrated diagnosis within 24 hours.
statements.evidence: ROBIN can detect single nucleotide variants (SNVs), copy number variants (CNVs) and structural variants (SVs) in real-time, and is able to inform a complete integrated diagnosis within 24 hours.
statements.note: The abstract states ROBIN detects SNVs, CNVs and SVs in real time and supports integrated diagnosis within 24 hours.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Intraoperative ROBIN results changed the extent of surgical resection in some patients.
statements.evidence: This information greatly improves upon the fidelity of smear diagnosis and can help surgeons tailor their approach, balancing the risks of surgery with the likely benefit.
statements.note: The abstract states that intraoperative classification can help surgeons in general but reports no case where ROBIN altered a surgical decision.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The exploratory cohort included 27 cervical adenocarcinoma cases, 22 living and 5 deceased, of which 23 were HPV-positive.
statements.evidence: Among 27 cases (22 living, 5 deceased; 23 HPV-positive, 2 HPV-negative, 2 unknown)
statements.note: The abstract gives 27 cases with 22 living, 5 deceased, and 23 HPV-positive.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: PREX1 protein expression ranked first among differentially expressed candidate proteins between living and deceased patients.
statements.evidence: PREX1 protein expression was identified as the top-ranked differentially expressed candidate protein
statements.note: The abstract reports PREX1 as the top-ranked differentially expressed protein (p = 4.29 × 10-5, q = 8.70 × 10-3).

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: PREX1 promotes cervical adenocarcinoma cell survival through activation of Rac1 signalling.
statements.evidence: In this exploratory cohort, elevated PREX1 protein levels and promoter hypermethylation of specific immune- and metabolic-related genes were associated with overall survival in endocervical adenocarcinoma.
statements.note: The abstract reports an association between PREX1 protein and survival but proposes no mechanism for it.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Kaplan-Meier analysis showed superior overall survival in patients with high PREX1 protein levels.
statements.evidence: Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrated superior overall survival in patients with high PREX1 protein levels.
statements.note: The abstract reports better overall survival with high, not low, PREX1 protein levels.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Drought-induced methylation changes at RLX_famc9 were transmitted to the next generation of wheat plants.
statements.evidence: We propose a model in which the RLX_famc9 family, enriched in differential methylation and exhibiting substantial sequence similarity to drought-responsive genes, is involved in the trans -regulation of stress-associated genes under control conditions
statements.note: The abstract compares methylation before and after drought within plants and says nothing about transgenerational inheritance.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Gene body methylation correlated strongly and positively with gene expression but negatively with stress responsiveness.
statements.evidence: gene body methylation was strongly positively correlated with gene expression but negatively with stress responsiveness
statements.note: The abstract reports a strong positive correlation of gene body methylation with expression and a negative one with stress responsiveness.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: The majority of drought-associated DMRs were located in intergenic regions and transposable elements.
statements.evidence: Most DMRs localised to intergenic regions and transposable elements (TEs)
statements.note: The abstract reports that most DMRs localised to intergenic regions and transposable elements, not gene bodies.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Many genes associated with DMRs kept their transcription stable under drought, suggesting a stabilising role for DNA methylation.
statements.evidence: Many DMR-associated genes maintained consistent transcription under stress, suggesting a stabilising role for DNA methylation.
statements.note: The abstract reports that many DMR-associated genes maintained consistent transcription under stress.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Fifteen patients (8%) carried fusions that are not covered by the UltraSEEK panel.
statements.evidence: Tissue-based molecular tumor profiling identifies 60 patients eligible for targeted treatment including fifteen (8%) harboring fusions currently not covered by UltraSEEK.
statements.note: The abstract states that the fifteen fusion-positive patients (8%) carried fusions currently not covered by UltraSEEK.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mutations were detected concordantly in tumour tissue and plasma in 82% of patients.
statements.evidence: in 82% of the patients, mutations are concordantly detected in tumor tissue and plasma.
statements.note: The abstract reports 82% concordance of mutation detection between tissue and plasma.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Among the 48 patients without tumour tissue NGS data, ctDNA analysis detected five therapeutically relevant mutations.
statements.evidence: In the absence of tumor tissue NGS data (n = 48), five therapeutically relevant mutations are detected.
statements.note: The abstract reports five therapeutically relevant mutations found by plasma analysis in the 48 patients lacking tissue NGS.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Patients treated according to ctDNA-detected mutations had outcomes similar to those treated according to tissue NGS results.
statements.evidence: Molecular tumor profiling of ctDNA identifies therapeutically relevant mutations at a comparable rate to tumor tissue-based NGS and might therefore serve as an alternative or complementary test for the detection of actionable variants in plasma.
statements.note: The abstract compares detection rates between plasma and tissue but reports no treatment outcomes.
